d610b4d111c183ae5578.title: Commander Coordinator
d610b4d111c183ae5578.description:
### **Company Introduction:**

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

### **Own Driver Engagement in Your Region**

The Commander Coordinator is the person who makes sure Airspace's driver network in a region runs well day to day. Where the Regional Network Manager owns the complete supply picture for the region — strategy, agent partners, and escalation — the Commander Coordinator owns the direct, ongoing relationship with every Commander and Copilot driver in that region: keeping Tier 1 drivers engaged, Tier 2 drivers progressing, and Tier 3 drivers identified and resolved before they affect service.

This is a support role to the Regional Network Manager, not a standalone strategy seat. You are the direct line to drivers — the person they know, trust, and call — and the person your Regional NM depends on to know the true state of the driver pool in the region at any given time.

Like agent support, driver support is a tiered model — attention scales with where a driver sits in the network rather than spreading evenly across the whole population. Tier 1 drivers get high-touch, relationship-driven attention. Tier 2 gets consistent, standard engagement and onboarding support. Tier 3 gets focused attention aimed at surfacing issues early and, once authorized, executing deactivation cleanly. Getting that allocation right is the core judgment call in this role.

### 

### **What You'll Do**

**Tier 1 Drivers (High performers)**

* Provide high-touch support to Tier 1 Commander and Copilot drivers, including regular check-ins to maintain engagement, address concerns, and reinforce performance standards
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Tier 1 drivers in your region

**Tier 2 Drivers (General population & new drivers)**

* Support the general driver population and new drivers through onboarding, ramp guidance, and routine engagement — helping drivers build familiarity with Airspace standards and expectations early
* Monitor Tier 2 performance through automated reporting, flagging drivers trending toward Tier 3 before issues escalate

**Tier 3 Drivers (Performance and conduct — managed out)**

* Identify and surface Tier 3 drivers — those whose behavior, reliability, or conduct warrants removal from the network — using automated reporting and case data
* Execute deactivation motions once authorized by the Regional Network Manager, managing the workflow through Salesforce case management

**General**

* Manage the driver case queue in Salesforce, triaging and routing escalations and maintaining accurate records for your region
* Partner with the Network Trainer to ensure onboarding and ongoing training content is being actioned by drivers in your region, flagging completion gaps by tier
* Support your Regional Network Manager with regional context and data, escalating issues with enough detail to enable a fast decision

**Partner Across the Network Organization**

* Work closely with your Regional Network Manager, who owns the complete supply picture for the region and is your escalation point for anything that exceeds your authority
* Partner with the Driver Recruiter to support onboarding as new drivers activate in your region
* Rely on automated performance reporting — built and maintained by the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations — to monitor driver tiers, flagging anomalies or field-level context back through your Regional NM
* Coordinate with Network Quality & Compliance on documentation standards during periodic audits

  

### **Requirements**

* At least 1-3+ years of experience in driver or contractor engagement, dispatch, account management, or another customer/partner-facing operational role — experience in logistics, transportation, or a gig/contractor network environment is strongly preferred
* Comfortable managing a caseload of drivers with different needs across tiers — high-touch relationship management for top performers, consistent standard engagement for the general population, and clear, unemotional documentation for drivers being managed out
* Strong documentation habits; comfortable owning a case queue in Salesforce or a comparable CRM
* Clear, empathetic communicator, comfortable delivering both positive engagement and difficult feedback
* Based within, or willing to be based within, your assigned region (Pacific Time zone preferred); comfortable with regular local travel to meet drivers in person
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  

### **Success Metrics**

**2026**

Tier 1 drivers in your region are engaged and retained at a high rate. Tier 2 drivers, including new drivers, are onboarding smoothly and building familiarity with Airspace standards. Tier 3 drivers are identified early and resolved through a clean, well-documented process once authorized. The case queue is current with no aging escalations, and your Regional NM has clear, timely visibility into the state of the driver pool.

**2027**

Your region shows measurable improvement in Tier 1 share of active drivers and in driver retention. Onboarding-to-first-segment time for new drivers is trending down. Your Regional NM relies on your judgment on escalations without needing to double-check the underlying work.

  

### **Your First 90 Days**

Get to know the drivers in your region — who they are, where they sit in the tier structure, and what's currently open in the case queue. Build a working relationship with your Regional Network Manager and establish a clear operating cadence together. Learn the automated reporting tools well enough to trust what they're telling you and to know when field context should override them.

### **Your First 180 Days**

Your regional driver engagement cadence is running consistently across all three tiers. The case queue is clean and current. Your Regional NM sees you as a reliable source of ground truth on the driver pool, and new drivers activating in your region are onboarding smoothly with your support.

  

### **Compensation**

* Hourly pay range: $22-$26/hr
* High-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
* Open PTO
* 401K with company match

### **Core Values:**

* **We are One Team**. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
* **We make an Impact**. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
* **We are Passionate**. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
* **We are Transparent**. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
* **We are Innovative**. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

  

**Airspace is proud** to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations.

**A friendly reminder:** Airspace will only contact candidates from an **@airspace.com** email, a no-reply notification from **no-reply@us.greenhouse-mail.io**, or a verified **LinkedIn profile.** We never request fees or sensitive personal/financial information during recruiting. If something seems suspicious or feels off, please reach out to us at **recruiting@airspace.com** before responding.

  

*For this role the acquisition of recruitment agencies is not appreciated, thank you for your understanding.*

### **Description and Requirements**

At the University of Phoenix, we are committed to the future of work by providing a fully remote, work-from-home environment. This strategy enables us to attract top talent nationwide. Are you looking for a rewarding and fulfilling position that offers challenging work and the opportunity to make a significant impact while collaborating with a team of fun, innovative individuals? Would you prefer to work with an organization that positively contributes to the world? If so, we would love to hear from you!

  

Are you searching for a rewarding, fulfilling position that offers challenging work and the ability to make a big impact while working side-by-side with a team of fun, innovative people? Ideally, would you like this position to be with an organization that makes a positive contribution to the world? If so…we would love to hear from you!

  
  

**About Us**

University of Phoenix is a leading higher education institution founded in 1976 by Dr. John Sperling. Our mission is to improve the lives of our students, their families and future generations through higher education. Our values (which hopefully you share) are: Brave. Honest. Focused.

  

Our University values and embraces all team members and their unique perspectives. We fundamentally believe in fostering an environment which deeply respects, celebrates, and actively encourages a diverse workforce. We are committed to hiring – and learning from – those who share our passion to help others achieve their educational aspirations.

  

We offer excellent benefits, an effective recognition program, and outstanding learning and development tools, including tuition vouchers for employees and their qualified family members.

**About the Position**

Student Support Specialists (Academic Counselors) work in a fast-paced, home-based virtual office environment to provide academic advisement, coaching, and customer service to students throughout the student lifecycle. Student Support Specialists are available throughout their assigned shift to accept/make student calls and complete work items delivered based on system priority. Student Support Specialists (Academic Counselors) use the University’s coaching model to partner with students, build connections, create action plans, motivate, and resolve student issues. Individuals in this role are the bridge for the student and University administration, ensuring students have access to information, policies, procedures, and requirements they need to make informed decisions. Student Support Specialists are natural problem solvers, on many occasions dealing with student issues that require research, de-escalation, and critical thinking. Individuals in this role must be available throughout their assigned shift to accept/make student calls and complete work items delivered based on system priority.

  
  

IMPORTANT:

You must reside in one of the following states: AZ, ID, NV, NM, MT, UT, TX, WY. You must have fully completed a bachelor's degree prior to applying. This position is expected to start on February 1, 2027.

  
  

About You:

* You are known for your ability to connect with people, building trusting relationships, and like to be someone others can count on.

* You thrive in an environment that is supportive with continuous feedback so you can be extremely helpful to those you connect with.

* You are a careful, analytical, thoughtful decision-maker and you enjoy having clear expectations and an opportunity to develop real expertise in your work.

* You have excellent written and interpersonal communication skills and exceptional organizational skills.

* You are known for being dependable, consistent, and methodical.

  

\*You have fully completed and conferred a bachelor's degree prior to applying\*

  
  

Schedule:

This position is required to start on February 1, 2027.

  
  

* Schedule during the first three months of onboarding is Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm AZ Standard Time. The first 6 weeks of employment are considered the "training period". Attendance is mandatory during the training period for success in this job.

* After the training period, your schedule will be either 9:00am - 6:00pm or 10:00am - 7:00pm (in your time zone), as determined by the needs of your department.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

1. Work full-time shift as scheduled to ensure high-quality service and availability for assigned student population, and to support department service levels and performance goals.

2. Engage in meaningful interactions and develop rapport across a diverse population of students to facilitate their academic progression.

3. Engage in meaningful interactions and develop rapport across a diverse population of students to facilitate their academic progression.

4. Assess student needs using all available tools, including the University’s coaching model and resources, to plan interventions to support student progression.

5. Act as a subject matter expert for students with respect to degree options, program requirements and graduation. Provide students with accurate, complete, and timely information on University policies and procedures.

6. Coordinate with students on all credit options to develop an academic plan that is best suited to their needs and career goals while taking into consideration how to minimize cost and time to graduation.

7. Establish and maintain professional working relationships across internal departments to ensure students benefit from a variety of professional knowledge and perspectives.

8. Recommend changes, share student and other feedback on ways to continuously improve the student experience.

9. Perform other duties as assigned or apparent.

Additional Primary Accountabilities for Academic Counselors not on Written team:

2. Perform and manage multiple tasks efficiently and effectively to maximize availability for incoming student calls while meeting department standards for productivity and quality.

Additional Primary Accountabilities for Academic Counselors on Written team:

1. Complete an average of at least 7-8 Activities Per Hour to include receiving and responding to chats, emails, and SMS work that is delivered systematically.

2. Perform and manage multiple tasks efficiently and effectively to maximize availability for incoming student inquiries while meeting department standards for productivity and quality.

3. Receive and make phone calls and complete work items delivered systematically per business need.

NOTE: The Primary Accountabilities above are intended to describe the general content and requirements of the position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Incumbents may perform all or most of the Primary Accountabilities listed above. Specific goals or responsibilities will be documented in incumbents’ performance objectives as outlined by the incumbents’ immediate manager.

None

* Experience with CRMs, Microsoft applications, video conferencing

* General knowledge of fields of study, such as business, education, technology, counseling and/or nursing

* Strong analytical skills to assess and evaluate students’ needs and determine appropriate courses of action.

3ace9175314d1317aca0.title: Business Development Sales Specialist
3ace9175314d1317aca0.description:
Join **W.B. Mason** as a **full-time Business Development Sales Specialist** and build your sales career by helping restaurants, local stores and businesses find the supplies they need every day. Your focus will be selling foodservice supplies, paper and janitorial goods, shipping and packaging materials and anything a business may need -connecting with business owners, understanding their purchasing needs, and winning new customers in your assigned territory. If you've worked in hospitality, retail, or customer service and enjoy meeting people and turning conversations into sales opportunities, this is your chance to grow with a supportive team. No sales experience? **No problem**! We'll train you, coach you, and set you up for success.

**THE CULTURE YOU'LL JOIN:**

At W.B. Mason, we help local businesses keep their operations moving. We sell everyday workplace essentials to businesses of all shapes and sizes. That means pizza boxes and napkins to your local MomPop shop, or school supplies and furniture for the public school system. It means keeping breakrooms across "Masonville" stocked with coffee, water, and everyday essentials, or providing the janitorial supplies that keep businesses fresh and clean. As a privately owned company with over a century of history, we've created an atmosphere where employees feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow. Our sales and delivery teams work together to serve customers and build lasting business relationships. We offer competitive pay, outstanding benefits, and ample growth opportunities. We love promoting from within and celebrating success at every level. If you're looking for a company with strong values, a supportive culture, and real career potential, W.B. Mason is the place for you!

**THE BENEFITS YOU'LL ENJOY:**

* **Pay of $60,000 - $65,000 annually with bonus opportunities**
* Blue Cross Blue Shield Health Plans with a $0 deductible (in-network) for all plans, with various plan designs
* Dental
* Vision
* 401k
* Short and long-term disability
* Company paid life
* Supplemental life
* Flexible spending program
* Medical and dependent care
* Company-paid cell phone plan with unlimited texting, calling, and data, including the option to add a family member for just $55 per month per line
* Paid holidays
* Monthly car allowance (rate depending on geography)
* Contest and vendor incentive earning opportunities

Your future in sales starts here - don't wait, apply today!

**IN THIS BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SALES SPECIALIST ROLE YOU WILL:**

You'll prospect by car and on foot throughout your assigned territory, visiting small stores and local businesses to introduce W.B. Mason's selection of almost anything needed to run a business. You'll connect directly with owners and purchasing decision-makers, learn what they use and how they buy, and identify opportunities to earn their business. Using marketing materials and product demonstrations, you'll explain how our supplies fit their day-to-day needs, offer custom pricing, follow up on opportunities, and turn prospects into new customers. As you uncover their needs, you'll introduce customers to additional products across our broad selection of business supplies. Working closely with our Inside Sales team, you'll convert leads, assist with onboarding, and transition new accounts smoothly to our account managers. This is a full-time, first-shift position with local travel within your assigned territory, and weekly branch sales meetings will keep you connected and supported as you grow your territory and your sales career.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR IN THIS BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SALES SPECIALIST POSITION:**

* Experience in restaurant roles (serving, bartending), retail, customer service, etc.
* Outstanding communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently
* Ability to converse, read, and write in English
* Physical ability to lift/move up to 25 lbs.
* Bachelor's Degree (BS or BA) from a four-year college (preferred)

So, what do you think? If you can meet these requirements and successfully perform the sales job as described above, we would be happy to have you join our team as a Business Development Sales Specialist. **No sales experience needed**. Apply now using our quick, easy, and mobile-friendly initial application!

**Position Summary:**

A Penske Customer Service Coordinator is focused on working with customers to schedule preventative maintenance requests, coordinate outside repairs, plan and manage the shop work plan.

**This position will be located at 1050 Swedesford Road in Berwyn, PA.**

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Develop daily and weekly workforce plans by factoring customer needs, estimated unscheduled repairs, available parts, technician skill sets and work hours to maximize customer service and productivity.

* Communicate with customers as needed for maintenance updates including changes to schedule or work, billing concerns, or to resolve service issues.

* Assure that all Penske Rental units are maintained and prepared for customers

* Ensure parts are available for scheduled work

* Hold vendors accountable for quality and adherence to schedule for outside work

* Provide customer service, assuring customers are satisfied and will return for additional business.

* Maintain shop productivity by optimizing the work plan

* Coordinate with district billing clerks as necessary

* Other projects and tasks as assigned by supervisor

**Qualifications:**

* 2 years of customer service experience required

* At least 1 year of hands on mechanical experience required

* 2 years of supervisory experience preferred

* At least 2 years of service department administration preferred

* High School diploma or equivalent required

* Associates Degree, Technical School Degree, or Bachelors Degree preferred

* ASE certification preferred

* Prior experience with service scheduling programs and diagnostic programs preferred

* The associate will be required to understand and comply with specific instructions, guidelines, rules, regulations, or other information established by Penske management

* The associate must be able to perform all work adhering to DOT, OSHA, and all Penske safety and maintenance policies; including but not limited to the correct selection and use of appropriate tools, PPE, machine guarding, and established best safety practice.

* Regular, predictable, full attendance is an essential function of the job

* Willingness to travel as necessary, work the required schedule, work at the specific location required, complete Penske employment application, submit to a background investigation (to include past employment, education, and criminal history) and drug screening are required.

**Physical Requirements:** The physical and mental demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* While performing the duties of this job, the associate will be required to move frequently, stand, walk, climb, bend, and sit for extended length of time throughout their scheduled working period.

* The associate is required to use their hands on a routine and daily basis to grasp, reach, touch, handle, feel, and/or otherwise operate required tools or controls.

* The associate must be able to work safely at heights using applicable ladders and elevated working platforms.

* The associate must be able to safely work in all weather conditions.

* Given the frequent movement of large trucks through the workplace, the associate must be able to see and hear in order to safely navigate the work environment.

* The associate must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 50lbs/23kg and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100lbs/45kg.

939c82f68d616df83910.title: HR Coordinator
939c82f68d616df83910.description:
Be part of something bigger at Minaris — where every role contributes to creating hope for patients around the world. As a global leader in cell and gene therapy development, manufacturing, and testing, we turn breakthrough science into real-world treatments that change lives. Our team of over 1,000 experts across North America, Europe, and Asia has helped bring transformative therapies to market.
  
  
At Minaris, you’ll join a purpose-driven community focused on innovation, collaboration, and patient impact. Whether you’re in the lab, in the cleanroom, or behind the scenes, your work will directly support life-saving therapies and make a lasting difference. If you're passionate about advancing cutting-edge science and believe in the potential of cell and gene therapies, we invite you to help shape the future of medicine—one patient at a time.
  
  
Position Summary
  
TEMPORARY ROLE INITIALLY
  
The HR Coordinator supports the HR Operations function by providing high-quality administrative, transactional, and systems support to ensure efficient and compliant delivery of HR services across the organization. This role plays a critical part in maintaining data integrity within HR systems, processing employee lifecycle transactions, coordinating documentation, and supporting standardized HR processes. The HR Coordinator serves as a key operational resource, helping ensure consistency, accuracy, and responsiveness in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
  
  
Working closely with HR Operations and HR Business Partners (HRBPs), the HR Coordinator helps manage onboarding and offboarding logistics, job changes, employee records, reporting, compliance tracking, and general HR inquiries. This role is especially important in supporting ongoing HR process improvements and system enhancements, helping to stabilize daily operations while contributing to increased efficiency and service excellence. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, systems-savvy, and capable of managing multiple priorities with professionalism and discretion.
  
  
Essential Functions and Responsibilities
  
HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Support
  

* Process and track employee lifecycle transactions including new hires, onboarding, internal transfers, promotions, compensation changes, and terminations.
* Ensure timely and accurate data entry and maintenance within the HRIS and other HR systems.
* Maintain employee personnel files and ensure documentation is complete, organized, and compliant with company policies and legal requirements.
* Support onboarding and offboarding logistics, including preparation of documentation, system access coordination, and checklist tracking.
* Generate routine HR reports (e.g., headcount, turnover, new hire status) and support ad hoc reporting requests.

HR Systems & Process Administration
  

* Maintain high standards of data integrity across HR systems; identify discrepancies and resolve errors proactively.
* Assist with HR systems updates, testing, and process improvements during system implementations or enhancements.
* Support documentation and standardization of HR processes and workflows.

Compliance & Risk Mitigation
  

* Track and manage required compliance documentation (e.g., I-9s, policy acknowledgments, certifications, required notices).
* Assist with internal audits and compliance reviews by preparing documentation and reports.
* Ensure confidentiality and proper handling of sensitive employee information.

HR Support
  

* Provide administrative support to HR, including scheduling meetings, preparing documentation templates, maintaining org charts, and tracking action items.
* Assist with coordination of performance management cycles, engagement surveys, and other HR programs.

Employee & Manager Support
  

* Serve as a point of contact for general HR inquiries; respond or triage questions appropriately.
* Provide professional, timely, and customer-focused support to employees and managers.
* Escalate complex or sensitive matters to appropriate HR team members.

Operational Excellence
  

* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within HR Operations.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance employee experience.
* Support special projects and other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  

* Understanding of HR compliance requirements and confidentiality standards related to employee records.
* Basic knowledge of HRIS systems and data management best practices.
* Familiarity with onboarding, offboarding, and personnel documentation processes.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail and accuracy in data entry, documentation, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook); ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with a professional and service-oriented approach.
* Strong administrative and coordination skills, including scheduling and tracking deliverables.
* Analytical skills to identify data discrepancies and support reporting needs.
* Problem-solving skills with the ability to escalate issues appropriately.

Education and Experience
  

* Associate’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required; Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* In lieu of a degree, equivalent combination of education and relevant administrative or HR experience may be considered.
* HR certification (e.g., SHRM-CP, PHR) is a plus but not required.

Quality Requirements
  

* Ensure compliance with all FDA and Worldwide Quality & Compliance regulations in all aspects of your work.
* Adhere to established procedures and protocols, prioritize continuous training and skill development, and uphold the highest standards of data integrity to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.

Disclaimer
  
The above information in this description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It does not contain nor is it intended to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
The estimated base salary range for each open position based in the United States of America is included for all our current openings. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. 09bb8585b26ca985a93e.title: Recruitment Lead
09bb8585b26ca985a93e.description:
ePathUSA is looking for a Recruitment Lead responsible for driving full-cycle recruitment efforts and supporting the organization's talent acquisition strategy. This role serves as a recruiting subject matter expert, partnering with hiring managers to attract, evaluate, and hire top talent while ensuring a positive candidate experience. The Lead Recruiter provides guidance on recruiting best practices, helps improve hiring processes, and plays a key role in meeting the company's workforce planning and growth objectives.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic recruiting consultation, including talent assessment, candidate engagement, offer development, and negotiation strategies.
* Lead sourcing, screening, and selection of candidates supporting government, state, and commercial client hiring needs.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and external clients while influencing hiring decisions and recruitment strategies.
* Ensure compliance with EEO, OFCCP, immigration, state employment, and client-specific hiring requirements.
* Provide day-to-day leadership and direction to sourcers and recruiting coordinators.
* Conduct labor market and talent research to support recruiting strategies.
* Partner with hiring managers to develop workforce plans, hiring strategies, screening criteria, and interview processes.
* Source, screen, interview, and evaluate candidates throughout the full recruitment lifecycle.
* Lead, mentor, and develop recruiters, sourcers, and recruiting coordinators through coaching and performance feedback.
* Monitor and report on recruiting metrics and hiring outcomes.
* Engage and influence clients and hiring managers regarding market conditions, talent availability, and hiring expectations.
* Utilize ATS and recruitment technologies to improve recruiting effectiveness and efficiency.
* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and hiring.
* Experience utilizing and optimizing Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment technologies.
* Experience managing high-volume recruitment efforts across multiple requisitions and business lines.
* Demonstrated ability to attract and successfully close top talent in competitive labor markets.
* Working knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws affecting recruiting and hiring practices.
* Experience partnering with hiring managers and stakeholders to develop recruiting strategies.

**Desired Qualifications**

* 6-8 years of recruiting experience, preferably in healthcare, technology, staffing, or government contracting environments.
* Working knowledge of OFCCP regulations and affirmative action requirements.
* Experience with Zoho Recruit and/or Paycom.
* Experience mentoring recruiters, sourcers, or recruiting coordinators.
* Strong candidate assessment and interviewing skills.
* Experience recruiting and building relationships with candidates from diverse backgrounds and professional experiences.
* Experience using recruiting metrics and reporting to drive hiring decisions.

a94c8124bf907ed43e2d.title: Part-Time Remote Psychiatric Practice Administrative Coordinator
a94c8124bf907ed43e2d.description:
Part-Time Remote Psychiatric Practice Administrative Coordinator

**Insight NP in Psychiatry, PLLC | Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours per Week**

**Compensation: $25–$35 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.**

Overview

Insight NP in Psychiatry, PLLC is a New York-based outpatient psychiatric practice seeking an experienced, organized, and compassionate Administrative Coordinator to support day-to-day practice operations.

Our practice provides psychiatric medication management and mental health care to adults, primarily through telehealth, with an emphasis on patient-centered, LGBTQ+ affirming care.

We are seeking a candidate with at least five years of administrative experience in a psychiatric, or behavioral health practice, preferably in an outpatient mental health setting. The ideal candidate is comfortable independently managing patient communications, scheduling, insurance coordination, and administrative workflows while maintaining a high standard of professionalism, empathy, and attention to detail.

This is a fully remote, part-time position requiring approximately 20 hours per week. We are looking for someone who is proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and capable of managing responsibilities independently while collaborating effectively with clinical providers and other administrative team members.

Duties and Responsibilities

* Manage patient scheduling, appointment confirmations, cancellations, and rescheduling.
* Respond professionally and compassionately to patient phone calls, emails, and portal messages.
* Coordinate new patient inquiries, registration, intake paperwork, insurance verification, and appointment preparation.
* Assist with insurance eligibility checks, billing inquiries, and resolution of routine insurance-related issues.
* Monitor administrative inboxes, patient requests, and outstanding tasks to ensure timely follow-up and resolution.
* Coordinate prescription refill requests, pharmacy communications, and prior authorization workflows, appropriately routing clinical matters to prescribing providers.
* Assist with medical records requests, referrals, forms, and other administrative documentation.
* Maintain accurate patient information and documentation in electronic health record (EHR) and practice management systems.
* Communicate with clinical providers regarding scheduling concerns, outstanding patient requests, and time-sensitive administrative issues.
* Follow established practice policies, maintain patient confidentiality, and comply with HIPAA requirements.
* Identify workflow issues, maintain task trackers, and contribute to improvements in administrative efficiency and the patient experience.
* Demonstrate strong ownership of assigned responsibilities, including proactive follow-through, problem-solving, and timely escalation of concerns.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* **Minimum of five years of administrative experience in a medical, psychiatric, or behavioral health practice.**
* Experience with patient scheduling, insurance verification, billing coordination, and electronic health record (EHR) systems.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage patient communications, administrative workflows, and follow-up tasks.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and ability to prioritize competing responsibilities.
* Professional, empathetic communication style and experience handling sensitive or challenging patient interactions.
* Understanding of HIPAA requirements, patient confidentiality, and appropriate handling of protected health information.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision while maintaining clear communication with the team.
* Reliable internet connection and access to a private, secure remote workspace.
* Availability to work approximately 20 hours per week during agreed-upon hours aligned with Eastern Time business operations.

**Preferred:**

* Direct experience working in an outpatient psychiatry or behavioral health practice.
* Experience with Headway, Alma, ICANotes, Zocdoc, or similar healthcare platforms.
* Experience coordinating prescription refill requests, prior authorizations, and pharmacy communications.
* Experience supporting multiple clinicians and managing administrative workflows in a group practice.
* Experience developing or improving administrative procedures, task trackers, and standard operating procedures.
* Familiarity with LGBTQ+ affirming healthcare and culturally sensitive patient communication.

Schedule, Compensation, and Work Arrangement

* Part-time position, approximately 20 hours per week.
* Fully remote, with applicants considered from different geographic locations.
* Work schedule established based on practice needs and mutual availability, with coverage aligned with Eastern Time business hours.
* Compensation of $26–$34 per hour, depending on relevant experience, qualifications, and responsibilities.
* Opportunity to contribute to a growing outpatient psychiatric practice and collaborate with a supportive clinical and administrative team.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume/CV and a brief description of your relevant healthcare administrative experience, including any experience in psychiatry or behavioral health.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have previously supported outpatient healthcare practices and can independently manage patient communications, scheduling, insurance coordination, and administrative follow-up.

Insight NP in Psychiatry, PLLC is committed to providing inclusive, respectful, and LGBTQ+ affirming care. We welcome applicants who share these values.

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Do you have at least five years of administrative experience working in a psychiatric, or behavioral health practice?
* Do you have direct experience with patient scheduling and insurance verification?
* Are you available to work approximately 20 hours per week during agreed-upon Eastern Time business hours in a fully remote position?

Work Location: Remote

11de3021b60b2dadbc27.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Rental Manager leads the Rental department and is responsible for both growing rental revenue and running day-to-day rental operations. The role entails a combination of developing customer accounts, supporting sales account managers seeking new rental business, and generating in-house sales growth with hands-on oversight of rental contracts, equipment check-out and check-in, and fleet utilization. The Rental Manager supervises Rental employees, resolves escalated customer issues, and works closely with the Sales and Repair teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage entry-level employees.
* Train new employees on the company policies, procedures, and best practices.
* Organize and oversee the schedules and work of assigned employees.
* Conduct performance evaluations that are timely and constructive.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

***Rental Sales & Account Growth***

* Drive rental revenue growth by supporting and coordinating with rental customers to keep them engaged, retained, and growing.
* Conduct needs assessments with customers and recommend appropriate equipment, rental terms, and add-on services for each job.
* Prepare rental quotes and proposals, and contribute to rental rate structures, pricing, and contract negotiations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for key rental customers, ensuring high satisfaction and repeat business.
* Support in-house sales growth by identifying cross-sell, upsell, and rental-to-purchase opportunities.
* Collaborate with operations, fleet, and marketing teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Partner with Sales to transition accounts as they scale.

***Rental Operations: Contracts, Check-Out & Check-In***

* Oversee the full rental contract process, ensuring agreements, terms, credit approvals, insurance certificates, and required customer documentation are complete and accurate before equipment leaves the yard.
* Manage equipment check-out, including availability, reservations, pre-rental inspections, and delivery and pickup scheduling.
* Manage equipment check-in, including return inspections and documentation of condition, damage, missing items, and usage, and ensure related charges are billed.
* Ensure rental contracts are invoiced accurately, closed out in a timely manner, and resolve billing questions.
* Track fleet availability and provide direction to employees to maximize fleet utilization.
* Ensure that Sales, Repair, and Production teams are informed of changes to company rental policies and services.
* Assist fleet and maintenance departments with equipment turnaround, off-site repairs, and fleet replacement goals and objectives.
* Manage after-hours emergency breakdown calls as required.

***Customer Service***

* Monitor and review calls or other correspondence between employees and customers to ensure consistency of customer experience.
* Resolve escalated customer complaints and issues while maintaining professionalism and prompt follow through.
* Prepare knowledge-based documents such as summaries and responses to frequently asked questions.
* Backfill Rental Coordinator duties as needed to ensure department consistency.

***Reporting, Forecasting & Planning***

* Maintain accurate records in CRM and ERP systems, including pipeline activity, quotes, contracts, forecasts, and account plans.
* Utilize and optimize CRM software to collect and report data on customer inquiries, complaints, and rental activity.
* Collect customer data, competitive rental rates, and utilization to inform pricing and account strategies.
* Identify opportunities to update or improve internal procedures and make recommendations to supervisor.

***General***

* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* Drive customer owned and/or company vehicles as needed.

**About AmeriPharma**

AmeriPharma is a rapidly growing healthcare company where you will have the opportunity to contribute to our joint success on a daily basis. We value new ideas, creativity, and productivity. We like people who are passionate about their roles and people who like to grow and change as the company evolves.

**AmeriPharma’s Benefits**

* Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life that fits your lifestyle and goals

* Employee assistance program to assist with mental health, legal questions, financial counseling etc.
* Comprehensive PTO and sick leave options
* 401k program
* Plenty of opportunities for growth and advancement
* Company sponsored outings and team-building events
* Casual Fridays

  

**Job Summary**

The Infusion Supply Coordinator supports safe and efficient home infusion therapy by managing patient-specific infusion supplies and equipment in coordination with Pharmacy, Nursing, and other operational teams. This role is responsible for reviewing and adjusting supply quantities based on patient therapy needs, nursing requests, utilization, and established workflows, ensuring that supplies are sent correctly for the specific catheter line in use to support safe infusion therapy. The coordinator serves as a primary resource for infusion supply questions and is expected to validate that requested supplies are appropriate for the patient's therapy and administration method before changes are made. The role also assists with identifying alternative products, researching new supply options, and submitting requests for new items when current inventory does not meet patient or operational needs. This position requires strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and an understanding of home infusion supplies, equipment, and patient-specific therapy requirements.

**Job Details**

* 100% remote position
* **Schedule**: Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:30pm PST
* **Salary Range**: $25 to $30 Hourly, DOE

  

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage patient-specific infusion supplies and adjust quantities based on therapy requirements, frequency of administration, patient utilization, and nursing or pharmacy requests.
* Review and validate supply requests to ensure the item and quantity requested are appropriate for the patient's therapy, vascular access, administration method, and frequency of use.
* Identify potentially excessive, insufficient, duplicate, or inappropriate supply requests and clarify discrepancies with Pharmacy, Nursing, or other appropriate team members before processing changes.
* Collaborate with pharmacists and nursing staff when supply needs require clinical clarification or when requested changes may affect medication administration, vascular access care, or patient safety.
* Research alternative or substitute supplies when requested products are unavailable, discontinued, backordered, or no longer preferred.
* Compare alternative products for intended use, compatibility, packaging, availability, and operational feasibility before recommending options for review.
* Submit requests for new supplies or products when existing inventory does not adequately meet patient, nursing, pharmacy, or operational needs.
* Maintain and update patient supply profiles to accurately reflect current therapy requirements and prevent unnecessary or outdated supplies from continuing to ship.
* Review recurring supply quantities and utilization to identify opportunities to reduce waste, prevent shortages, and improve supply standardization.
* Coordinate with Pharmacy, Nursing, Intake, Production, Shipping, and other departments to resolve supply-related questions and ensure patients receive the appropriate supplies for treatment.
* Assist with urgent or same-day supply needs by evaluating the request, determining what is required, and coordinating appropriate fulfillment or escalation.
* Monitor supply inventory concerns and communicate anticipated shortages, unusual utilization, or product needs to the appropriate Production or Supply Chain leadership.
* Assist with supply standardization initiatives by identifying commonly used products, unnecessary variation, and opportunities to establish preferred supply options.
* Maintain accurate documentation of patient-specific supply changes, special requirements, substitutions, and relevant communications in the pharmacy system.
* Support equipment management, including coordinating equipment needs, replacements, returns, and pickups as applicable.
* Assist with equipment recovery efforts and collaborate with Specialty Pharmacy or other departments when demand letters or additional follow-up are required.
* Participate in inventory audits, supply utilization reviews, quality improvement initiatives, and workflow development to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary supply costs.
* Escalate clinical questions to a pharmacist or nurse when a supply request requires clinical judgment beyond the scope of the coordinator role.
* Additional duties and responsibilities in different areas of the department on an as-need basis or determined by management
* Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, collaboration, and service excellence.
* Take primary ownership of: Patient-specific supply quantities and adjustments, review and validation of supply requests, supply utilization and waste reduction, alternative product research, new supply/product requests, patient supply profile accuracy, supply and equipment issue resolution, and cross-department coordination of infusion supply needs.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous experience in home infusion, specialty pharmacy, medical supplies, DME, pharmacy operations, healthcare supply chain, or a related setting preferred.
* Familiarity with infusion supplies, vascular access supplies, administration sets, pumps, and related equipment.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to evaluate whether supply quantities and requests are reasonable.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to research products, compare alternatives, and communicate findings clearly.
* Ability to manage multiple patient-specific requests while maintaining accuracy and appropriate prioritization.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with pharmacists, nurses, technicians, shipping personnel, and other interdisciplinary teams.
* Attention to detail
* Supply utilization and inventory awareness
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Patient-specific supply management
* Cross-functional communication
* Research and product evaluation
* Documentation accuracy
* Prioritization and follow-through
* Cost and waste awareness
* Understanding of role boundaries and appropriate clinical escalation

  

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or healthcare-related education preferred.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using patient management or inventory systems such as CPR+ preferred.

  

**AmeriPharma’s Mission Statement**

Our goal is to achieve superior clinical and economic outcomes while maintaining the utmost compassion and care for our patients. It is our joint and individual responsibility daily to demonstrate to outpatients, prescribers, colleagues, and others that We Care!

**Physical Requirements**

The following physical activities described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and expectations. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is continuously required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 20 pounds and occasionally lift/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must have the ability to regularly walk commercial properties, parking areas, and exterior grounds; use stairs and access building operational areas as required; work in both office and field environments; and occasionally lift and carry light maintenance supplies or equipment.

**EEO Statement**

The above statements are intended to describe the work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. The duties and responsibilities of this position are subject to change and other duties may be assigned or removed at any time. AmeriPharma values diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an AAP/EEO employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability or any other legally protected class.

**Michigan Educator Workforce Initiative - Program Data & Operations Associate**  
(Part-time temporary, remote)  
  
**Who We Are**

Michigan Educator Workforce Initiative (MEWI) is a hub for educator talent. MEWI adopts a “systems-adjacent” approach, working closely with K-12 districts, early learning centers, and higher education institutions to design and support innovative approaches to recruiting and developing teachers and school leaders. We are committed to hiring a team that represents the diversity our state offers.

**What We Do**

MEWI is an adaptive organization that plays the roles necessary to foster innovation and long-term, systematic capacity-building for Michigan’s educator workforce pipeline. Depending on the context, MEWI plays flexible roles: designing, implementing, funding, and supporting innovative programs to recruit, develop, retain, and elevate new and veteran teachers and school leaders. MEWI captures insights and learnings from our work to share with systems leaders, policy makers, parents, and community leaders and convenes educators to share best practices, collaborate, and problem-solve.

**What You’ll Do**

The Program Data & Operations Associate will build and manage the data systems that track MEWI program participants and outcomes and will own the data reports and deliverables that program teams, funders, and grant managers rely on. You will also provide targeted operational support for program meetings and events. You will work closely with MEWI’s operations team and multiple Directors of Programs to ensure program data is accurate, well-documented, and ready to inform decisions.

**Who You Are**

The ideal candidate for this role:

* Is a critical and analytical thinker. This person likes to get in the weeds, enjoys analyzing data, and translates findings clearly for different stakeholders.
* Is detail-oriented and a creative problem solver. This person catches errors before they spread, anticipates challenges, and proactively solves complex problems.
* Is self-directed and independent. This person will work independently on complex projects and needs to be comfortable with ambiguity.
* Has strong project management skills. This person tracks multiple deliverables and deadlines at once and connects the dots across programs and teams.
* Has excellent communication skills. This person writes and presents clearly and adapts communication to different audiences.
* Takes ownership of their work while operating within a feedback-rich culture. This person puts solutions forward, adapts based on input from MEWI staff, and documents their work so MEWI staff can sustain it after the contract ends.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) from an accredited college or university
* 2-4 years of experience in data management, operations, and/or project management involving multiple functions
* Experience developing, using, and maintaining data collection and management tools and systems
* Experience producing data reports, dashboards, and presentations for internal and external audiences
* Proficient with software and technology, including Zoom, Microsoft Suite, and/or Google Suite
* Experience and comfort working in a virtual environment
* (Preferred) Experience using Google Data Studio, Asana, and Qualtrics
* (Preferred) Experience maintaining records and grant reporting

**Responsibilities**

*Systems management*

* Support in building out a comprehensive project plan
* Maintain data collection tools and systems for program functions
* Manage participant and program data in Google Suite, including Google Data Studio and related tools, ensuring records are complete, accurate, and current
* Conduct regular data quality audits against established standards, resolving discrepancies with program teams
* Document all systems, processes, and data definitions so MEWI staff and its partners can sustain them after the contract ends

*Data reporting and deliverables*

* Monitor progress against deliverables; identify and propose solutions to challenges and elevate concerns appropriately
* Produce data reports, dashboards, presentations, and written summaries that share program information with MEWI team members and external stakeholders
* Analyze program data and translate findings into actionable insights for program teams
* Prepare data and supporting documentation for funder and grant reporting deadlines

*Operational support*

* Support operations for virtual and in-person program meetings and events, including registration and communications
* Collaborate with the operations team and Director of Program to streamline program processes and data flows
* Provide responsive support to program stakeholders on data, systems, and logistics questions

**Anticipated Schedule**

The selected individual will work as a part-time temporary employee with an estimated 8-10 hours per week. This position will operate from November 2026 through June 2027.  
  
**Compensation**

An hourly rate of $35-$45 (commensurate with experience). As a part-time temporary employee, this role is not eligible for MEWI employee benefits.

**Requirements**:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Computer Science, Business, Finance or any relevant field or study (i.e. equivalent training or certifications) required.

* Experience with accounting and AP/AR functions required.

**Why work for #teamloanDepot**:

* Aggressive compensation package based on experience and skill set.
* Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative culture where people from all backgrounds can thrive.
* Work with other passionate, purposeful, and customer-centric people.
* Extensive internal growth and professional development opportunities including tuition reimbursement.

At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we're growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

*The application window will be open until at least* ***November 18th, 2026****. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.*

***This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.***

  

**Role Description:**

The **Procurement and Helpdesk Operations Manager** is responsible for running and improving our day-to-day Procure-to-Pay (P2P) PO, vendor and support operations. In this role, you will lead purchasing & helpdesk operations, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to streamline requisition-to-PO workflows, govern compliance, and drive root-cause resolution for high-impact operational bottlenecks. You'll be the go-to person for troubleshooting workflow and transaction problems in Coupa and SAP, while reviewing incoming requests for accurate coding, approvals, and compliance.

Beyond daily ticket and queue management, you will oversee supplier onboarding and master data updates, partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and internal stakeholders to clear exceptions, and monitor open requests and aging to keep transactions moving fast. You will also guide business users through purchasing processes, keep documentation up to date, and identify opportunities for continuous process improvements across our systems.

**In this role, you'll:**

* **PO Lifecycle & Stakeholder Alignment:** Oversee purchase requisition and PO creation, partnering cross-functionally to resolve policy and contract exceptions.
* **Finance Helpdesk Management:** Lead intake triage and ticket resolution, monitoring queue aging and SLA performance to clear operational bottlenecks.
* **Compliance & Requisition Review:** Review requisitions for completeness, GL coding accuracy, supporting documentation, and approval matrix compliance.
* **Supplier Operations:** Streamline new vendor onboarding and maintain accurate supplier profile data across entities.
* **P2P Systems Administration:** Administer Coupa and SAP, troubleshooting workflow, permission, and integration issues with enterprise IT and vendors.
* **Process Optimization & Enablement:** Analyze ticket trends to automate manual tasks and P2P processes, guide users on policies and maintain updated SOPs and knowledge base documentation.

**At a minimum we'd like you to have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of comprehensive, progressive experience in Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Procurement Operations, or Financial Operations.
* 3 years of experience utilizing, configuring or implementing Coupa
* 5 years of experience managing procurement operations and offshore vendor relationships to ensure efficient, accurate processing and service delivery.

**It's preferred if you have:**

* 3 years of experience configuring, implementing, or optimizing SAP to drive overall workflow efficiency.
* A high degree of autonomy, setting strategic priorities, executing complex projects, and driving cross-functional alignment without direct oversight.
* Experience leveraging modern technologies like AI, automation to identify technical system enhancements, resolve software defects, and streamline financial workflows.
* Exceptional attention to detail and strong interpersonal skills with a proven track record of managing competing priorities and resolving complex challenges.

The US base salary for this full-time position is $106,400 - $171,700 + bonus + benefits. As pay varies by location, your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process.

f19bcff4e1a52953d7ed.title: Global Customer Operations Transformation Lead
f19bcff4e1a52953d7ed.description:
We’re a high-impact, global nonprofit social enterprise that believes in using technology for the greater good. Since 1987, we’ve been building partnerships and alliances with individuals, corporations, nonprofits, and governments across the globe – all committed to helping nonprofits fully access the profound power of technology and a connected world — and use it to improve lives.  
  
But we won’t stop there: as technology and global needs change, so do we. We’re creating new, community-driven platforms and mobile apps and are enhancing our offerings so that nonprofits around the world have the resources they need to build a brighter future for millions of individuals.  
  
We’re innovators, leaders, influencers, social entrepreneurs, and technologists drawn together by a shared vision: to make the world a better place through technology. Join us!  
  
**Full-time engagement | 8-9 months**

1. **Engagement Overview**

TechSoup is seeking an experienced Global Customer Operations Transformation Lead for an approximately 8-9 month, full-time engagement. The individual or consulting firm will provide senior, hands-on leadership for TechSoup's Global Customer Operations Transformation, working across Customer Service, Validation support, technology, AI and automation, process redesign, workforce transition, and change management.

This is not primarily an advisory engagement. TechSoup is looking for a leader who can take the transformation from design through implementation, stabilization, and handover. Significant current-state analysis and target-state design work has already been completed. The next phase requires dedicated leadership to convert those decisions into an integrated implementation plan, drive execution across multiple teams, resolve dependencies, establish new operating practices, and ensure that the resulting model becomes sustainable day-to-day operations.

2. **Transformation Context**

TechSoup is redesigning how nonprofit organizations receive support, complete registration and validation, and gain access to products and services globally. The transformation combines workflow redesign, AI-enabled automation, human support, technology implementation, and organizational change. This redesign and implementation work will also lay down the foundational structure for future business needs including sales, membership engagement, and entry point to TechSoup.

The transformation covers three connected areas

* Global Customer Service: shared knowledge resources, conversational AI, global live chat with human escalation, tickets, callbacks, office hours, routing, service hours, and chat quality review.
* Global Customer Registration and Validation: search, claim or register organizations; automate organization, agent, eligibility, and fraud checks; provide human review for exceptions; support checkout checks and revalidation; and phase migration toward Dynamics.
* Global Operating Model and Workforce Transition: define service tiers, roles, queue ownership, training, KPI baselines, quality monitoring, governance, and a phased delivery plan.

The engagement must treat these areas as one operating transformation. The need is broader than implementing a platform or adding staff. Technology, process, service delivery, organizational structure, roles, training, measurement, and change management must move together.

3. **Purpose of the Engagement**

A. Turn the target design into an executable program

Translate the existing design, decisions, and workstreams into a single integrated transformation roadmap with clear deliverables, owners, dependencies, milestones, decision points, risks, acceptance criteria, KPI measurement, and resource requirements.

B. Drive implementation

Actively lead execution across Customer Service and Validation rather than serving only as an advisor. The lead must be comfortable moving from strategy to process design, technology, people, implementation, measurement, and operational stabilization.

C. Build the new Global Customer Operations model

* Global workflows and clear ownership
* Defined service levels and standards
* AI-enabled approach with effective human escalation
* Quality management and workforce capability
* Appropriate regional and country exceptions within a globally consistent model

D. Leave behind a sustainable organization

By the end of the engagement, TechSoup leadership should be able to run the new model without continued dependence on the contractor. Knowledge transfer, documentation, operating routines, KPI ownership, governance, and management capability are required outcomes.

4. **Scope of Work**

4.1 Transformation Program Leadership

* Build and maintain the integrated transformation roadmap.
* Translate strategy and decisions into implementation requirements.
* Establish clear workstream accountability and decision rights.
* Maintain dependencies, risks, issues, actions, and decisions.
* Prepare and facilitate project-team, KPI, and steering reviews.
* Identify delivery obstacles and bring decisions to the appropriate leaders quickly.
* Maintain focus on business outcomes rather than activity completion.
* Provide concise executive reporting on progress, decisions, risks, resources, and KPI movement.

4.2 Customer Operations Transformation and Data Management

Lead the operationalization of a global Customer Service model that includes:

* A clear digital strategy
* A shared, country-aware knowledge capability
* Global approach to customer interactions (including data management), chats, tickets and solution process
* An operating model and structure to support escalations and program consultation where appropriate
* Improved process for quality assurance and higher CSAT and better user experience
* Feedback loops into knowledge, policy, and training

4.3 Operating Model and Workforce Transformation

This work is central to the engagement and must not be treated as secondary to technology implementation. The lead will help design and implement:

* Global Customer Operations structure, and definition of functional roles
* Responsibilities and decision rights
* Service tiers and skill-based agent structure
* Workforce coverage and capacity model
* Training and capability requirements
* Quality-management responsibilities
* Transition from current roles to the future structure

4.4 AI and Technology Enablement

The lead does not necessarily need to be the technical implementer, but must be technically fluent enough to lead an AI-enabled Customer Operations transformation. Relevant experience should include several of the following:

* Knowledge management
* CRM and case management
* Intelligent routing and workflow automation
* Customer-service analytics
* AI quality assurance, monitoring, and governance

5**. Performance and Measurement**

The lead will establish reliable operational management mechanisms, validate KPI definitions and baselines, assign owners, and implement recurring reporting. Current project targets.

The lead should confirm measurement methodology, data availability, exclusions, segmentation, and baseline integrity before using these measures for acceptance or benefit claims. AI deflection should be reviewed together with resolution, quality, escalation, customer experience, and operating efficiency, rather than optimized in isolation.

6. **Expected Deliverables**

Mobilization and program control

* Integrated transformation implementation plan
* Confirmed workstream structure and RACI/decision rights
* Dependency map
* Risk, issue, action, and decision registers
* Governance cadence and executive reporting format
* KPI baseline and measurement framework

Organization and transition

* Future-state Global Customer Operations operating model
* Roles, responsibilities, service tiers, and staffing/capacity model
* Training and capability plan
* Change and communications plan
* Operational playbook and leadership dashboard
* Formal operational handoff and knowledge transfer

7. **Candidate or Firm Requirements**

Required experience

* 10+ years of relevant experience in global customer operations, service transformation, contact centers, or customer-experience operations.
* Leadership of at least two significant customer or service-operations transformations from design through implementation.
* Experience leading global or multi-region operations.
* Experience redesigning customer-support processes and organizational operating models.
* Strong program and transformation-management capability.
* Experience implementing AI or automation in customer-facing operations.
* Experience with CRM or customer-service platforms.
* Experience designing KPIs, service levels, quality frameworks, and operational dashboards.
* Demonstrated change-management experience, particularly where employee roles and responsibilities changed.
* Ability to work directly with senior executives and hands-on with operational and technical teams.

Strongly preferred

* Microsoft tech stacks in Customer Service experience.
* Experience with global nonprofit, membership, marketplace, or service organizations.
* Experience building 24 by 7 models.
* Knowledge-management transformation experience.
* Experience combining AI-enabled self-service with human-supported service.
* Experience with compliance, KYC-like verification, or other exception-based operational processes.

8. **Profile We Are Looking For**

The strongest candidate is likely to have served in one or more of the following roles:

* VP or Head of Customer Operations
* VP or Head of Customer Experience
* Customer Service Transformation Director
* Contact Center Transformation Leader
* Customer Operations Operating Model Lead
* Senior Customer Operations or CX Transformation Consultant

9. **Engagement Model**

Duration

Approximately 8-9 months

Commitment

Full time

Provider model

Individual independent contractor or consulting firm providing a named senior lead

Working style

Embedded with TechSoup's global project team

Expected focus

Implementation, operational readiness, stabilization, and handover

**Requirement for a consulting company:**

The proposed named transformation lead must be committed substantially full time for the duration of the engagement. TechSoup is not seeking a partner-led strategy engagement that transitions delivery primarily to junior consultants. Any substitution of the named lead requires TechSoup approval.  
  
**TechSoup is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to ensuring that all employees and applicants receive equal consideration and treatment, regardless of race, color, creed, gender (including gender identity or gender expression), religion, marital or domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical, mental or medical disability, sex, sexual orientation, citizenship, military service status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law or local ordinance.**  
  
**The hourly compensation range for this full-time, contract engagement is approximately $58–$72 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.** **depending on experience, qualifications, and scope alignment. The final rate will be determined based on the scope of services, relevant skills and experience, specialized expertise, location, and market considerations. This is an independent contractor engagement and is not eligible for TechSoup employee benefits.**
